abilities._comment: Was TRIGGERED on ON_PLAY_ACTIVATE_ATTACK. Moon Chakra is an INSTANT whose text -- 'the next time you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent 3; if you've transcended, instead prevent 5' -- has nothing to do with playing an attack. It resolves when the card is played. The two amounts are one choice, not two stacked preventions, so it is a branch.

_comment: 'If you've transcended this turn' now reads the turn event recorded by the canonical transcend (CR 8.5.48a). Was a private flag — and the flag names were misspelled inconsistently (TRANSCEDED / TRANSCEDED_THIS_TURN), so the cards could not even have collided into working by accident.
